mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT x.* FROM inspect_record_share s LEFT JOIN xunjian_schedule x ON s.job_id = x.job_id WHERE s.viewer = #{username} AND x.id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT R.ID, R.INSPECT_TIME AS NAME, '2' AS isShare, R.INSPECT_STATE AS inspectStatus FROM INSPECT_RECORD R RIGHT JOIN INSPECT_RECORD_SHARE S ON R.ID = S.INSPECT_RECORD_ID WHERE R.INSPECT_CODE = #{jobId} AND S.VIEWER = #{username} ORDER BY R.INSPECT_TIME DESC
